description: Six copies of upright (vertical) looped cursive from an unused public-domain copybook, Barnes's National Vertical Penmanship No. 6 (1898): running sentences, adult model writing engraved for pupils to copy. Family 1, upright variant (#342).

the world, is a great sugar market.

chief center of japan for foreign trade.
barnes-019-java: java, no larger than the empire
state, has four times the population.
barnes-021-milton: milton, the poet, was born the year
before hudson sailed up the beautiful
river that now bears his name.

ter in the world, and, except new york,
